attempts.summary: Built a real block-level filesystem snapshot/rollback capability for /srv/data on node1 using device-mapper dm-snapshot (no LVM package or repo access was available, so an origin+COW loop-device setup was wired manually). Demonstrated a full modify-then-restore cycle verified by sha256 checksum equality, made the setup persist across reboot via a systemd unit, and completed the mandatory single-node restart verification with a changed boot_id and confirmed post-restart data/service recovery.
